question: How should Window Spy read other windows on KDE Plasma (Wayland blocks global window/mouse inspection)?
probes: Test on Arch KDE with kdotool installed (Wayland) and xdotool/xprop (X11)
resolution: Implemented with kdotool on KDE Wayland and xdotool/xprop/ImageMagick on X11 (title, class, process, pid, id, mouse and window positions; colour only on X11). Status bar / control text have no Linux equivalent and stay empty. Needs a test on a real Arch KDE machine; this Windows workspace can't run it.
